items.source: Override this method to add custom Converter and/or Formatter delegates to the common FormattingConversionService.
items.translation: 重写此方法以添加自定义的Converter和/或Formatter委托，它们都指向通用的FormattingConversionService。

items.source: Add custom Converters and Formatters for performing type conversion and formatting of annotated controller method arguments.
items.translation: 添加自定义的Converters和Formatters，以执行对注解控制器方法参数的类型转换和格式化。

items.source: Add Converters and Formatters in addition to the ones registered by default.
items.translation: 添加 `Converters` 和 `Formatters`，除了默认注册的那些之外。

items.source: A specialization of FormattingConversionService configured by default with converters and formatters appropriate for most applications.
items.translation: 一个特化的FormattingConversionService，默认配置了适用于大多数应用程序的转换器和格式化器。

Support classes for the formatting package,
providing common implementations as well as adapters.
items.translation: 格式化包的支持类，提供通用实现以及适配器。

items.source:
Register Formatters and Converters with a FormattingConversionService
through a FormatterRegistry SPI.
items.translation: 通过 FormatterRegistry SPI 注册 Formatter 和 Converter 到 FormattingConversionService。

items.source:
Add formatters appropriate for most environments: including number formatters,
JSR-354 Money & Currency formatters, and JSR-310 Date-Time formatters,
depending on the presence of the corresponding API on the classpath.
items.translation: 添加适用于大多数环境的格式化程序：包括数字格式化程序、JSR-354 货币和货币格式化程序，以及 JSR-310 日期时间格式化程序，具体取决于类路径上是否存在相应的 API。
